title: Multi-output Gaussian process prediction of physical fields under linear equality constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.25709v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We address the simultaneous prediction of multiple high-dimensional physical fields governed by linear equality constraints, a setting that arises in many real-world applications in physics machine learning. Gaussian process (GP) regression is a widely used surrogate modeling approach due to its effectiveness in small-sample regimes and its ability to provide uncertainty quantification. However, applying GP models in this setting raises two major challenges: the high dimensionality of the discretized output fields and the enforcement of the physical constraint in predictions. For the latter, a common strategy consists in deducing one output from the others via the constraint relation. Through a benchmark, we show that this deductive approach is sensitive to the arbitrary choice of which output to deduce, affecting both predictive accuracy and uncertainty quantification. translated_title: 线性等式约束下多输出高斯过程物理场预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25709v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们解决了由线性等式约束控制的多高维物理场的同步预测问题，这一设置在物理机器学习的许多实际应用中出现。高斯过程（GP）回归是一种广泛使用的代理建模方法，因其在小样本情况下的有效性和提供不确定性量化的能力而受到青睐。然而，在此设置中应用GP模型面临两大挑战：离散化输出场的高维性和预测中物理约束的执行。对于后者，常见策略是通过约束关系从其他输出中推导出一个输出。通过基准测试，我们表明这种推导方法对选择哪个输出进行推导的任意性敏感，影响预测精度和不确定性量化。因此，需要一种将所有场平等对待的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在物理线性约束下同步预测多个高维场的高斯过程方法，克服了传统推导法对输出选择敏感的问题，从而提升了预测精度和不确定性量化的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Gaussian process method for simultaneously predicting multiple high-dimensional physical fields under linear equality constraints, overcoming the sensitivity of traditional deductive approaches to output selection, thereby improving predictive accuracy and uncertainty quantification consistency.
